name: Teeth Whitening
shortDescription: Dentist-supervised whitening in the office or at home, with enamel-safe gels.

seo.description: Professional teeth whitening in Santa Clarita. In-office in about an hour or custom take-home trays, supervised by Dr. Neda Moezzi. $59 new patient exam.

hero.lead: Lift coffee, wine and everyday stains with whitening that is matched to your teeth and your sensitivity. In the office in about an hour, or at home at your pace.
hero.imageAlt: Dr. Neda Moezzi, DDS, in her Valencia office

intro.heading: Whitening that is planned, not guessed
paragraphs: Coffee, tea, red wine, tobacco and simple age all dull enamel over time. Professional whitening lifts those stains with dentist-grade gels that are stronger and more predictable than store-bought strips. At Valencia Smile Expert every whitening plan starts with an exam, because whitening works best on healthy teeth, and a shade match so we can set realistic expectations and measure the result.

There is no single formula here. Dr. Moezzi tailors the strength, timing and method to your shade goal and your sensitivity, so you get a noticeably brighter smile with little to no sensitivity. Choose in-office whitening for a fast result, custom take-home trays for gradual brightening, or a combination plan for both. Patients across Santa Clarita and Valencia come to us for exactly this kind of measured approach.

whoItsFor.heading: Who it's for
whoItsFor.intro: You are likely a good candidate for professional whitening if:
items: You have surface stains from coffee, tea, wine or tobacco
Your teeth are healthy, with no untreated decay or gum disease
You want fast, noticeable results without harming your enamel
You are after a lasting improvement, not a quick fix
Your smile looks yellowed or duller than it used to

benefits.heading: Why patients whiten with us
benefits.intro: The difference is supervision: a dentist chooses the gel, checks your teeth and watches your sensitivity.

items.title: Customized care
items.text: Strength and timing matched to your shade goal and your sensitivity level.

items.title: Dental-grade materials
items.text: Professional whitening agents that are enamel-safe and used under supervision.

items.title: Minimal sensitivity
items.text: Modern formulas and careful technique keep discomfort low for most patients.

items.title: Real results
items.text: Professional gels lift deeper stains than store-bought kits can reach.

items.title: Guidance throughout
items.text: From consultation to follow-up, you deal with Dr. Moezzi and her team, not a box.

options.heading: Whitening options
options.intro: Three ways to whiten, depending on how fast you want results and how you like to work.

items.title: In-office whitening
items.text: Best for quick, dramatic results. About one hour in the chair with a professional high-concentration gel. Results are immediate.

items.title: Custom take-home trays
items.text: Best for flexible, gradual whitening. Wear your custom trays with professional gel for 30 to 60 minutes a day; results build over 7 to 14 days.

items.title: Combination plan
items.text: Best for long-term brightness. An in-office boost for immediate results, plus a take-home kit for maintenance.

process.heading: How whitening works here
process.intro: Three steps, whether you whiten in the office or at home.

steps.title: Consultation and shade match
steps.text: Dr. Moezzi examines your teeth, talks through your goals and records your current shade. This sets realistic expectations and shapes your plan.

steps.title: Whitening treatment
steps.text: In the office, professional-grade gel is applied in a single visit. For take-home whitening, you are fitted for custom trays. All products are enamel-safe and chosen with sensitivity in mind.

steps.title: Aftercare and follow-up
steps.text: You leave with tips to protect your results and avoid common staining habits, plus the option of touch-ups or extra gel for home use.

technology.heading: What supports the result
technology.intro: Whitening is low-tech by design, but the exam around it is not.

items.title: Digital X-rays
items.text: Confirm there is no untreated decay before whitening, so the gel does not reach a vulnerable tooth.

items.title: Intraoral cameras
items.text: Document your starting shade and show the change at your follow-up.

items.title: iTero digital scanner
items.text: Digital impressions for custom take-home trays that fit closely and keep gel where it belongs.

cost.heading: Cost and financing
cost.text: Whitening is a cosmetic treatment, so dental insurance generally does not cover it. We keep pricing straightforward: after your consultation and shade match you receive a written estimate for the option you choose, whether in-office, take-home or the combination plan, before any treatment begins. Flexible financing is available if you prefer to spread the cost. Whitening starts with a healthy mouth, and if you are new to the practice the $59 new patient special covers the exam and X-rays we need before we whiten.

faqs.q: How long do teeth whitening results last?
faqs.a: Results often last from 6 months to 2 years, depending on your oral hygiene, diet and habits. Coffee, red wine and tobacco shorten that window; limiting them stretches it. Periodic touch-ups with take-home gel are an easy way to hold your shade.

faqs.q: Will my teeth be sensitive afterward?
faqs.a: Some patients notice mild sensitivity for a day or two, especially to cold. Our treatments are chosen and timed to keep this to a minimum, and we will recommend aftercare steps and products, such as a sensitivity toothpaste, that help if it occurs.

faqs.q: Is professional whitening better than over-the-counter options?
faqs.a: Yes, for most people. Professional gels are stronger and are applied under a dentist's supervision, so they reach deeper stains and work faster than strips or kits, with less risk to enamel and gums. You also get a shade match, custom-fit trays and someone to call with questions.

Whitening performed under dental supervision is considered safe for healthy teeth and gums. The exam beforehand matters: we check for decay, gum disease and exposed roots that could cause problems, and we choose the gel strength and timing to protect your enamel.

faqs.q: How white will my teeth get?
faqs.a: Results vary with the type and depth of staining, but many patients see an improvement of 2 to 8 shades. At your shade match we give you a realistic expectation based on your current color and the cause of the discoloration, before you commit.
